quote: In this paper, our work focuses on KGC, specifically addressing two tasks: (i) triple classification, assessing the correctness of a given triple (h, r, t), and (ii) link prediction, identifying the most plausible tail entity t for a given query (h, r, ?).
This paper aims to develop a structure-aware LLM that excels in various KGC tasks by effectively integrating structural information.
outputs: Structured responses (True/False for triple classification; entity names for link prediction)
The model generates responses for triple classification (True/False) and link prediction (target entity).

quote: Following previous work, we evaluate triple classification using four standard metrics: accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, and assess link prediction with two metrics: Hits@1 and MRR.
